title: Swiss Autoimmune Hepatitis Cohort Study
brief_summary:
Research project in which biological material is sampled and health-related personal data is further used and collected.

Coded data are used.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of AIH, either type I or type II
* Only patients living in Switzerland

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
study_population: Patients diagnosed with AIH, either type I or type II living in Switzerland
